doc.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Closing thanks
summary: Monk thanks Ed and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Cool. Well listen, thanks for your time today.
My pleasure. Thanks for having me. It’s great to be up here with you and see where you keep all your records man, with the spider’s webs on it all.
Guess what we got in here. All right. We’ll see you again I’m sure.
I hope so, Monk, thank you. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -23-
